mapper.sql: TRIAL_NO, NCT_ID, BUSINESS_NO, SOURCE_TYPE, TITLE, OFFICIAL_TITLE, BRIEF_SUMMARY, PHASE, STUDY_TYPE, RECRUITMENT_STATUS, ELIGIBILITY_TEXT, SEX, MIN_AGE, MAX_AGE, ENROLLMENT_TARGET, ENROLLMENT_CURRENT, LEAD_SPONSOR, INSTITUTION_NAME, LOCATION_TEXT, CONTACT_NAME, CONTACT_PHONE, CONTACT_EMAIL, START_DATE_TEXT, COMPLETION_DATE_TEXT, REVIEW_STATUS, REJECT_REASON, VIEW_COUNT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO CLINICAL_TRIAL T USING ( SELECT #{nctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS NCT_ID FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.NCT_ID = S.NCT_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.SOURCE_TYPE = #{sourceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, T.TITLE = #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
T.OFFICIAL_TITLE = #{officialTitle,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
T.BRIEF_SUMMARY = #{briefSummary,jdbcType=CLOB},
T.PHASE = #{phase,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
T.STUDY_TYPE = #{studyType,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS = #{recruitmentStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
T.ELIGIBILITY_TEXT = #{eligibilityText,jdbcType=CLOB},
T.SEX = #{sex,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
T.MIN_AGE = #{minAge,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
T.MAX_AGE = #{maxAge,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
T.ENROLLMENT_TARGET = #{enrollmentTarget,jdbcType=NUMERIC},
T.LEAD_SPONSOR = #{leadSponsor,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
T.INSTITUTION_NAME = #{institutionName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
T.LOCATION_TEXT = #{locationText,jdbcType=CLOB},
T.CONTACT_NAME = #{contactName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
T.CONTACT_PHONE = #{contactPhone,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
T.CONTACT_EMAIL = #{contactEmail,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
T.START_DATE_TEXT = #{startDateText,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
T.COMPLETION_DATE_TEXT = #{completionDateText,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
T.REVIEW_STATUS = #{reviewStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, T.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( TRIAL_NO, NCT_ID, BUSINESS_NO, SOURCE_TYPE, TITLE, OFFICIAL_TITLE, BRIEF_SUMMARY, PHASE, STUDY_TYPE, RECRUITMENT_STATUS, ELIGIBILITY_TEXT, SEX, MIN_AGE, MAX_AGE, ENROLLMENT_TARGET, ENROLLMENT_CURRENT, LEAD_SPONSOR, INSTITUTION_NAME, LOCATION_TEXT, CONTACT_NAME, CONTACT_PHONE, CONTACT_EMAIL, START_DATE_TEXT, COMPLETION_DATE_TEXT, REVIEW_STATUS, VIEW_COUNT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_CLINICAL_TRIAL.NEXTVAL, #{nctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NULL, #{sourceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{officialTitle,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{briefSummary,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{phase,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{studyType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{recruitmentStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{eligibilityText,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{sex,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{minAge,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{maxAge,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{enrollmentTarget,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0, #{leadSponsor,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{institutionName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{locationText,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{contactName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{contactPhone,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{contactEmail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startDateText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{completionDateText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reviewStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM CLINICAL_TRIAL WHERE TRIAL_NO = #{trialNo} AND REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT FROM CLINICAL_TRIAL WHERE REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND RECRUITMENT_STATUS = 'RECRUITING' AND ( SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' OR ( SOURCE_TYPE = 'API' AND ( UPPER(NVL(NCT_ID, '')) LIKE 'KCT%' OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(LOWER(LOCATION_TEXT), 'south korea') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(LOCATION_TEXT, '대한민국') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(LOCATION_TEXT, '한국') > 0 ) ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, NVL(UPDATED_AT, CREATED_AT) DESC, TRIAL_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT T.TRIAL_NO, T.NCT_ID, T.BUSINESS_NO, T.SOURCE_TYPE, T.TITLE, T.OFFICIAL_TITLE, T.BRIEF_SUMMARY, T.PHASE, T.STUDY_TYPE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, T.ELIGIBILITY_TEXT, T.SEX, T.MIN_AGE, T.MAX_AGE, T.ENROLLMENT_TARGET, T.ENROLLMENT_CURRENT, T.LEAD_SPONSOR, T.INSTITUTION_NAME, T.LOCATION_TEXT, T.CONTACT_NAME, T.CONTACT_PHONE, T.CONTACT_EMAIL, T.START_DATE_TEXT, T.COMPLETION_DATE_TEXT, T.REVIEW_STATUS, T.REJECT_REASON, T.VIEW_COUNT, T.CREATED_AT, T.UPDATED_AT, ( SELECT MIN(D.DISEASE_NAME) FROM TRIAL_DISEASE TD JOIN DISEASE D ON D.DISEASE_NO = TD.DISEASE_NO WHERE TD.TRIAL_NO = T.TRIAL_NO ) AS CONDITIONS_TEXT, 1 AS PREMIUM_PROMOTED FROM TRIAL_PROMOTION P JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = P.TRIAL_NO AND T.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO JOIN BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION S ON S.SUBSCRIPTION_NO = P.SUBSCRIPTION_NO AND S.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO WHERE P.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (P.START_DATE IS NULL OR P.START_DATE <= SYSDATE) AND (P.END_DATE IS NULL OR P.END_DATE >= SYSDATE) AND B.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND T.SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND T.REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND S.PLAN_TYPE = 'PREMIUM' AND S.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (S.END_DATE IS NULL OR S.END_DATE > SYSDATE) ORDER BY NVL(P.START_DATE, P.CREATED_AT) DESC, P.PROMOTION_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRIAL_VIEW_HISTORY ( VIEW_NO, TRIAL_NO, MEMBER_NO, VIEWED_AT ) SELECT SEQ_TRIAL_VIEW_HISTORY.NEXTVAL, T.TRIAL_NO, #{memberNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSDATE FROM CLINICAL_TRIAL T WHERE T.TRIAL_NO = #{trialNo} AND T.REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED'
mapper.update: UPDATE CLINICAL_TRIAL SET VIEW_COUNT = NVL(VIEW_COUNT, 0) + 1 WHERE TRIAL_NO = #{trialNo} AND REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED'
